data.narrative:
Bedrock Robotics is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company founded by Boris Sofman, Kevin Peterson, Ajay Gummalla, and Tom Eliaz. The target holds a current post-money valuation of $1.75B and has raised $350M+ to date. The relevant peer set comprises 9 private robotics companies at Series B and Series C stages, including Generalist AI ($2.0B), Dexterity ($1.6B), Hadrian ($1.6B), Agile Robots ($1.0B), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B), alongside one public comparable.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, applying a typical Series B-to-next-stage multiplier of 1.9x to the $1.8B last post-money valuation, yields $3.3B. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produced a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $2.0B. The peer set reflects current market pricing for robotics companies at similar development stages.

Triangulation of both methods supports a valuation range of $1.4B to $3.8B, with a midpoint of $2.5B. The wide dispersion reflects material tension between stage-progression momentum and near-term peer benchmarking. Key uncertainties include the degree to which Bedrock's operational metrics and market position justify stage-typical step-ups, and the relevance of Series C comparables given potential stage-discount effects on Series B pricing.
